description: Three-portal arena (south, east, west) with a richly-connected interior. The west cluster forms a small clique near the west gate (zs5jga + r3atwz + y4x395 + hs4mnt). The west-side staging anchors (5ecisd + fh6d0r) bridge into the east-half via the center pivot (xrbrz1 / hm71z5). The east gate has its own entry hub (cfp45d) with two transit anchors (h2x9yv + ix9xvp) plus a side pocket (4pz0k6). South entry (lard9j) connects to the south-center clique only.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-0.18, 23.74) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.55, -0.81) — gate on the east (high-X) side
portals.west: spawn_west at (-23.12, -13.95) — gate on the west (low-X) side

traversalNotes: south ↔ east: spawn_south → south_inner → south_e → east_mid_n → east_inner → spawn_east.
south ↔ west: spawn_south → south_inner → south_w → west_inner_e → west_mid → west_inner → spawn_west.
east ↔ west:  spawn_east → east_inner → east_mid → west_inner_e → west_mid → west_inner → spawn_west.
WEST CLIQUE (west_inner + west_pocket + west_mid + west_nw + west_far) covers the west half — densely connected for combat.
EAST POCKET (east_pocket) is a single-degree-ish detour off east_mid / east_inner.

DISPATCH RULE: same-cluster objectives stay within their cluster (west clique stays in west; east pocket via east_inner / east_mid; south-center via south_w / south_e). Cross-cluster transit goes via west_inner_e or east_mid_n as the bridge anchors.
Same primitive family as paru-A tc3 (3-portal E-shape) but with a much denser west clique and explicit east pocket detour.
